signature: SUBROUTINE ZDROT( N, ZX, INCX, ZY, INCY, C, S )

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the order of the vectors cx and cy. N must be at least zero.

params.name: x
params.reference: ( 1 + ( N - 1 )\*abs( `INCX` ) ). Before entry, the incremented array `ZX` must contain the n element vector cx. On exit, `ZX` is overwritten by the updated vector cx.

params.name: incx
params.reference: On entry, `INCX` specifies the increment for the elements of `ZX`. `INCX` must not be zero.

params.name: y
params.reference: ( 1 + ( N - 1 )\*abs( `INCY` ) ). Before entry, the incremented array `ZY` must contain the n element vector cy. On exit, `ZY` is overwritten by the updated vector cy.

params.name: incy
params.reference: On entry, `INCY` specifies the increment for the elements of `ZY`. `INCY` must not be zero.

params.name: c
params.reference: On entry, C specifies the cosine, cos.

params.name: s
params.reference: On entry, S specifies the sine, sin.
